title: Splunk Security Advisories - 2025-11-12
description:
Merged 3 splunk security advisories published on 2025-11-12. Original advisory IDs: SVD-2025-1103, SVD-2025-1102, SVD-2025-1101

Titles:
- Third-Party Package Updates in Splunk Enterprise - November 2025
- Risky command safeguards bypass using the “/services/streams/search“ REST endpoint through “q“ parameter in Splunk Enterprise
- Open Redirect on Web Login endpoint in Splunk Enterprise
